experiment_data.hypothesis: Claude Sonnet 4.6 exhibits the same binary ambiguity effect (+30-40pp) and type hierarchy (spec > ling) observed in GPT models, confirming cross-model generalizability of C1-C3. As a frontier API model from a different provider, consistent results strengthen the claim that ambiguity effects are model-agnostic.
